name: The Shed

viewpoint.note: the Hudson Yards public square about 180 m east-south-east of the building, looking west-north-west at The Shed and its telescoping shell

inside_footprint.name: the Shops / 30 Hudson Yards podium, modelled as a 34 m plinth in c_hudson_yards

terrain_m.note: heightmap at the recorded viewpoint, bilinear (DATA_CONTRACTS section 3); after J85 it is the surveyed platform level, inside the podium footprint

position_audit.not_moved_because: the note puts the camera on the public square, which lies west of that footprint, but the exact position along the strip between the podium's west face and the subject is a choice a person should make, not a measurement; J82's rule: measured, published, not corrected. A real-polygon candidate: the centroid of the DoITT planimetric plaza polygon (feat_code 6000, 1,571 m2) at NYC_TM (-4394.7, 5895.1) = (40.753074, -74.00204), from which the Shed bears 291.3 deg at 77.8 m and the Vessel 350.5 deg at 81.7 m (docs/DEVIATIONS.md J85)

estimated_viewpoint.explanation: No camera GPS in the file metadata; the viewpoint is the standard photographer position for this view (the Hudson Yards public square about 180 m east-south-east of the building, looking west-north-west at The Shed and its telescoping shell) and the azimuth 290 deg is the bearing from there to The Shed (40.75333, -74.00290).
